description:
Xelius DRS, performance and comfort combined

By making the radical decision to combine the best features of two bikes that have won numerous professional races, Lapierre's engineers have made a bold choice. However, this machine is about more than just speed: its sleek new lines and streamlined design (particularly visible in the fork) offer a whole new perspective. What's more, the thoroughly reworked 3D Tubular technology frees up the entire seat tube, allowing it to flex along its entire length.

The result is significantly improved comfort that subtly complements the responsive geometry of the rear triangle. Performance and comfort are further enhanced by compatibility with a wide variety of tyres (up to 32mm) to suit a multitude of road surfaces (cobblestones, off-road, gravel, etc.). A born competitor!

Carbon UD SLI Team frame

Carbon UD SLI Team fork

Headset Integrated Acros headset

Handlebar Lapierre Semi-integrated Combo UD carbon handlebar, -10°, 370mm/90mm(XS,S), 390mm/100mm(M), 410mm/110mm (L), 410mm/120mm (XL/XXL), Drop: 125mm, Reach: 72mm, Flare: 5°.

Lapierre carbon seatpost, Xelius DRS, 0mm Offset, L: 350mm(XS,S,M), 400mm (L,XL,XXL)

Accessories: Front and rear wheel locks and multi-tool lever + specific Garmin & Wahoo GPS holder
